title: Coordinated launch calendar & release-train playbook for runtime/console/API
creator: Priya Shah
description: Create a single coordinated launch calendar and operational playbook to align runtime, console, and API release trains. Deliverables: canonical launch calendar, gating criteria for release windows, automated notifications, rollback/runbook, and cross-team dry-run checklist. Aim to reduce late-stage integration slips and ensure consistent canary/rollback behavior across tiers.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical calendar published and synced to company calendar
Playbook with gating criteria reviewed and approved by Eng/Design/Security
Automated alerts configured (Slack + Email) for stage transitions
End-to-end dry run completed with simulated outage and successful rollback
All dependent PRs and infra tickets identified and assigned
decisions: Adopt bi-weekly synchronized release window on Tuesdays 17:00 UTC
Use percentage-based canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automated rollback at SLO degradation >5%
Console and API deployments will follow runtime by one day to allow smoke testing on runtime
next_steps: Finalize calendar template and publish to Confluence (owner: Miguel)
Create GH meta-issue to track feature gates and infra changes
Request security sign-off for release automation (SEC-71)
risk_assessment: Risk: Capacity contention during concurrent runtime and console rollouts - Mitigation: staggered windows and quota reservations
Risk: Unidentified model compatibility causing regressions - Mitigation: pre-release compatibility tests and canary on low-traffic region
Risk: Notification fatigue - Mitigation: concise stage-specific alerts only
